technical.summary: Bullish technical setup with strong EMA alignment and breakout signals, but overbought conditions and weak momentum confirmation limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: CNP shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 37 days.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for CNP; neutral market conditions with stale congressional activity (173+ days old) and absent recent news data provide insufficient conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (207.5) indicates extreme market stress, CPI event in 1 day adds near-term volatility; utilities defensive but credit-sensitive; earnings in 37 days provides some buffer but overall environment highly unfavourable.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 9/21 golden cross with three white soldiers and new 10-day high provide technical confirmation of upside momentum in a defensive utility sector.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators, zero fundamental conviction, macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 207.5), earnings risk in 37 days, and price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA create a high-probability reversal setup that negates technical strength.
